title: outbox: is_valid_mailbox_host no IP-range guard — SSRF from delivery path
description: Trigger: contact record has mailboxHost='10.0.0.1' (set via discovery or Contact/set). is_valid_mailbox_host in kith-peer only checks character set (alphanumeric + . - : port), not IP ranges. outbox_tick calls PeerHttpClient::deliver to that host, POSTing JMAP payloads to RFC-1918/link-local/loopback addresses. is_valid_fetch_host in peer_fetch.rs does the proper SSRF guard but is never called on the delivery path — only on blob fetch. Fix: apply the same CGNAT/ULA allowlist in is_valid_mailbox_host, or call is_valid_fetch_host before the delivery attempt in outbox_tick.
